text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix race, the Arima 
Kinen! Standing at the pinnacle among the 
formidable contenders from both Classic 
and Senior classes is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin!! With her one-of-a-kind 
late burst of speed, she seizes victory!!

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes... you've become so strong. You've 
grown so strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You really are something... You pulled it 
off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket hoists Narita Taishin up 
onto her back. Biwa Hayahide supports her 
as she slightly wobbles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Taishin, looking bigger 
than anyone else, basked endlessly in the 
thunderous applause and roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Good grief...! What is with those guys, 
seriously?!
